name: @audio-ripper/desktop
description: Desktop app for high-fidelity YouTube audio extraction and metadata tagging
author: Omar

scripts.predev: npm run prepare:binaries && npm run build -w @audio-ripper/shared && npm run build -w @audio-ripper/core
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:binaries && npm run build -w @audio-ripper/shared && npm run build -w @audio-ripper/core
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
